summary: Root cause is outside this package. Tabbing into the sticky header scrolls the page: html has scroll-padding-top: 80px and the header controls sit inside that band, so Chromium scrolls up about 458 px on each focus before the link is activated. Back then restores that shifted position correctly. The fix belongs in app/globals.css or components/shell/Header.tsx (shell-perf): give header focusables scroll-margin-top: -80px. Requested as a cross-package change.
